title: Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates — Return template: MA(BS)3 Part IIIb
summary: HKMA's document ledger lists this item as 'Return template: MA(BS)3 Part IIIb,' dated 13 June 2025 and associated, per that same ledger listing, with a consultation titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates.' HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve this document, including on an independent re-verification pass for this review, so nothing about what the wider consultation package specifically proposes, how many related documents it comprises, or how the unrelated 'miscellaneous amendments' portion is treated can be confirmed against HKMA's own text. Only the bare ledger listing above is reflected here.
why_it_matters: HKMA requires the banks it supervises to file standardised prudential returns. The ledger listing's own title ties this specific return-template document to a 'cryptoassets standard,' but since the document's own text could not be retrieved during either drafting or re-verification, that link is not independently confirmed. For a newcomer, the useful read, if the listing holds up, is that cryptoasset exposure may be becoming a routine, reportable line item in bank supervision rather than only a niche licensing topic — but that remains unverified pending access to HKMA's own source text.
